{
  "name": "hitokoto",
  "version": "0.6.1",
  "description": "A line from Hitokoto (一言) in a band above the prompt, refreshed on a timer, per session, per prompt or once a day",
  "author": {
    "name": "hoobnn",
    "url": "https://github.com/hoobnn"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/hoobnn/hoobnn-agent-mods",
  "repository": "https://github.com/hoobnn/hoobnn-agent-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "hitokoto",
    "quote",
    "band",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "visible": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show the band",
      "description": "Draw the line above the prompt; /hitokoto off and /hitokoto on change this too",
      "default": true
    },
    "refreshMode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Refresh mode",
      "description": "interval: every intervalMinutes; daily: one line a day, the same in every session; session: a new line each session; prompt: a new line each prompt",
      "options": [
        "interval",
        "daily",
        "session",
        "prompt"
      ],
      "default": "interval"
    },
    "categories": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Categories",
      "description": "Hitokoto category letters, comma separated (a 动画, b 漫画, c 游戏, d 文学, e 原创, f 网络, g 其他, h 影视, i 诗词, j 网易云, k 哲学, l 抖机灵); empty takes any",
      "default": ""
    },
    "intervalMinutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Refresh interval (min)",
      "description": "Minutes between new lines in interval mode (at least 1)",
      "default": 30
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Language of /hitokoto's replies and errors (the lines themselves are Chinese); auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "zh-Hans",
        "zh-Hant",
        "ja",
        "ko",
        "es",
        "fr",
        "de",
        "pt-BR",
        "ru"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    }
  }
}
